description: TO_CHAR / TO_VARCHAR date-time format model: Snowflake elements (YYYY/YY/Y, MMMM/MON/MM, DD/DY/D, HH24/HH12/HH/H, MI, SS, AM/PM) translate to a formatter with greedy longest-match tokenisation, unmatched characters pass through as literals, and a non-date string is returned unchanged. Snowflake has NO full-name DAY or MONTH elements - both live-verified on 2020-01-15, a Wednesday: 'MONTH' tokenises MON+T+H giving Jan, a literal T and unpadded hour 0, while 'DAY' tokenises D+A+Y giving unpadded day 15, a literal A and 2-digit year 20. Month and day names render in title case, a documented approximation since the format element's case is not propagated. Over a VARCHAR input TO_CHAR is single-argument, so supplying a format is an arity error while the bare form passes the text through. Converted 1:1 from functions/ToCharDateTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach dt fixture is inlined per test.
